model.architecture: existing ResNet18 encoder/classifier family, separately versioned weights and task head

supervision.source_label: carry locked manifest class, label unit and provenance; never infer from model output
supervision.prohibition: never copy case/bag label onto individual slices as slice truth
supervision.bag_sampling: a single fixed sampler and ordered bag manifest must be bound by SHA before train/eval; this interface does not choose or change the sample
supervision.bag_aggregation: mean raw per-slice logits over the fixed ordered bag; resulting logits have CASE/BAG scope

predictor_contract.slice_input: finite float32 prepared scalar tensor [B,1,H,W] with exact model preprocessing ID/SHA bound outside this contract
predictor_contract.slice_output: finite raw logits [B,2] in ordered class-map IDs; prediction scope SLICE_RESPONSE
predictor_contract.differentiable_f: eval mode, frozen parameters, differentiable input; do not wrap in no_grad/inference_mode, detach inputs, or cache away the Mask gradient
predictor_contract.bag_input: fixed ordered bag of prepared slices plus immutable sampler/version binding
predictor_contract.bag_output: mean over slice logits -> finite raw [B,2], prediction scope CASE_BAG
predictor_contract.bag_explanation: requires separately versioned adapter that masks the selected slice(s) inside the fixed bag, reruns the model on changed pixels, reaggregates, and holds the original bag target fixed; current LOC E1/E2 v5 only accepts SLICE scope

matched_algorithm_comparison.E1: same fixed 16/32/64 pixel grids, fill, valid support, candidate area budgets, target policy, and deterministic tie rules within each evaluated model
matched_algorithm_comparison.E2: same original E2 core/CPF constraints and all-logit Ls plus continuous-mask Lm definition within each model; freeze exact source/config SHAs before model calls
matched_algorithm_comparison.interpretation: report each model's own logits, margins, probabilities, area and localization evidence; raw absolute logit losses across different classifiers/calibration are not comparative performance
matched_algorithm_comparison.semantic_match: cross-model class comparison is permitted only after ordered class IDs and source/task label semantics are independently bound; otherwise label outputs by model class ID

evidence_boundary: This interface is not a fitted classifier, training permission, model-call permission, slice-label source, bag explanation result, or clinical validation.
